description.name: Entry
description.text: Seven single ranged jump attacks (0.90 each) capped at 19999, grants [Attach Water 3 with Stacking], [Damage Cap +10000], [Zenith Mode] and [Zenith Mode: Kimahri] to the user

description.name: Zenith Mode: Kimahri
description.text: Increases [Water Infusion] damage bonus by 20%, cast speed x1.10 for PHY attacks, Water abilities trigger 1 additional time, casts Spirit Attack: Kimahri after using a Water ability (max 1), maximum HP +1500, grants [Astra] after taking the next action, removed if the character hasn't [Zenith Mode]

description.name: Ronso Jump+
description.text: Seven single ranged jump attacks (1.05/1.10 each) capped at 9999/19999 after 0-2/3+ uses

description.name: Azure Lance+
description.text: Three single ranged jump attacks (1.10 each), grants [Instant Cast 1] to the user

description.name: Spirit Attack: Kimahri
description.text: Grants [Weakness +30% Boost 3] to self/all allies with at least 0-3/4+ Dragoon or X members in the party

description.name: Attach Water 3 with Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Water Level by 3 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Water 3

description.name: Zenith Mode
description.text: Replaces certain Hero Abilities, certain Hero Abilities don't consume uses, after the duration the status only expires after the character takes an action
